svg.title: Information Extraction: Content In, Named Fields Out
svg.desc: Documents, images, audio and video go into an Azure Content Understanding analyzer, which uses OCR, speech recognition and generative models plus your schema, and returns named fields as markdown and JSON your systems can use. The schema is applied by meaning: "Invoice No.", "Invoice #" and an unlabelled number on the page all map to the same field, InvoiceNumber.
svg.text: Information Extraction: Content In, Named Fields Out
One analyzer handles every content type and applies your schema by meaning, not by label.
